title: Review and simplify the CMake build files using KISS principles
scope: Selected by the user on 2026-11-01. Simplify root/test CMake and adopt the explicitly selected C++20 baseline, keeping application behavior and public build options unchanged.
request: The user considers the CMake files to be in poor shape and wants them reviewed and fixed to be as simple as practical: keep it simple, straightforward, and easy to maintain.
expected: Clear, minimal CMake files that express the application's real build requirements without redundant settings, obsolete fragments, or unnecessary abstraction, while preserving supported build behavior.
implementation_notes: Review the root and test CMake files together, including how presets and build scripts depend on their options and target names.
Check minimum-version requirements, repeated settings, target structure and dependencies, QML/resource registration, platform/configuration gates, and obsolete comments or workarounds.
Prefer direct, target-based CMake and straightforward conditions. Introduce helper functions or extra files only when they make the result materially simpler.

Retain necessary complexity, especially conditional desktop keyboard resources/imports, Android packaging, test isolation, and optional model coverage. Establish why a workaround exists before removing it.
Do not combine the structural cleanup with functional app bug fixes or change public build options without identifying the need.
Update build documentation and scripts only where the simplification requires it. No specific current build failure is claimed by this maintainability report.
acceptance_criteria: Review findings and the resulting CMake structure are understandable without tracing unnecessary helper layers.
Remove proven duplication and obsolete configuration while preserving required targets, resources, dependencies, and options.
Keep the application and tests using the production QShopper library rather than duplicating model compilation.
Preserve desktop Debug/Release keyboard gating and Android's native-keyboard packaging behavior.
Preserve normal CTest execution, isolated test data/settings, and the separately optional coverage workflow.
Run tools/verify-windows.ps1 and validate additional build/configuration paths affected by the eventual changes, including Android where relevant.
Record what was simplified and any necessary complexity retained; keep the cleanup separate from functional backlog fixes.
evidence: Explicit user request to add a KISS-oriented CMake review and cleanup to the backlog on 2026-10-28.

implementation.baseline: User selected C++20 as the stable baseline. Set the required standard once, synchronize .clang-format and AGENTS.md, and require CMake 3.25 at the root to match the existing preset requirement. Qt minimum remains 6.10. No application C++ or QML source changes.
simplification: Remove duplicate standard requirements, stale import/debug comments and diagnostic output, the child minimum-version declaration, and explicit AUTOMOC settings already supplied by qt_standard_project_setup.
Flatten the desktop-keyboard condition without changing AUTO/ON/OFF behavior. Let configure_file create its output directory.
Keep the library declaration and its dependencies together, followed by the executable and platform settings. Retain direct CMake rather than adding helper abstractions.
Set common QML test environment values and Windows DLL-path modifications once; append only the keyboard test's plugin environment separately. Preserve test commands, timeouts and isolation.
Review CMakePresets.json, tools/verify-windows.ps1 and build-android.ps1; no script/preset changes needed. Document configuration commands and validation in tests/README.md.
implementation.retained_complexity: Production QShopper library ownership of model compilation; conditional keyboard .qml.in resources and module dependencies; Android manifest/icon staging and native IME override; macOS bundle properties; independent tests and optional model coverage.

verification.toolchain: CMake 3.30.5, Ninja 1.12.1, Qt 6.12.0 msvc2022_64 kit with installed MSVC 19.51.36260; Android NDK r27c Clang 18.0.3.
verification.windows: tools/verify-windows.ps1 passes configure/build and all four CTest entries: 157 UI, 19 flow, 6 real-keyboard and 61 model records, zero failures/skips (284.73 seconds). Generated compile flags select C++20.
verification.contracts: Before/after CTest plans retain names, commands, timeouts and environment values (environment order normalized). All three generated resource manifests retain identical content after line-ending normalization; the baseline JSON capture stored normalized text rather than raw bytes.
verification.release: Fresh Ninja Release/AUTO builds app/tests with keyboard disabled; 61 model, 5 theme/build-gate and 6 preview records pass.
verification.multi_config: Fresh Ninja Multi-Config/ON Release builds app/tests; 61 model, 5 theme/build-gate, 6 preview and 6 actual-keyboard records pass. Fresh Debug/OFF, Multi-Config/OFF and Multi-Config/AUTO configurations verify disabled loader/module dependencies and three-test registration; these three configurations were not built or run.
verification.coverage: Fresh coverage-ON configuration locates Python and the MS collector, exposes model_coverage and retains PROFILE/DEBUG:FULL/INCREMENTAL:NO instrumentation flags. No new coverage collection or percentage result is claimed.
verification.android: Fresh x86_64 Debug APK builds using gnu++20 with the desktop keyboard explicitly requested ON but correctly disabled by Android. Signed APK installed only on emulator-5580. All 13 native Back/IME/popup/saved-data checks pass. The build log records successful packaging; the lingering command session was stopped after artifact/signature/native verification, so its cleanup exit is not reported as build exit zero.
verification.limits: No physical-device install, ARM64 app rebuild or macOS build. An ARM64 C++20 syntax probe passed but does not certify the full app. Offscreen desktop tests do not certify complete visual appearance.

implementation.packaging_observation: Old and new x86_64 APKs contain byte-identical Qt Virtual Keyboard native library/plugin payload despite the disabled QML loader. No new runtime regression is established; deferred deployment review is tracked separately as DEV-008.
implementation.remaining: None for the accepted CMake cleanup. DEV-008 remains a separate deferred packaging review.
implementation.user_validation: 2026-11-01: user accepted the result and requested ticket closure and commit.
